atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

primaryTarget: headed Test Suite WASM/WebGPU CPU profile
hypothesisMarkdown:
## Post Request Handoff CPU Profile Hypothesis

A fresh accepted-build CPU profile after removing 716 request-to-prepaint style computations will show the reduced style-construction family and identify the next dominant gpux-owned mechanism more reliably than the pre-handoff profile.

**Attempt Count:** 1.

### Scope Lock

Read-only CPU profiling and sampled-stack aggregation only. Production source, dependencies, Test Suite fixtures, diagnostics schemas, performance fixes, and durable memory/skill claims are forbidden.
measurementPlanMarkdown:
### Measurement Plan

Run the canonical wide DataTable benchmark once at DPR 1 and DPR 2 in one headed Chromium/WebGPU process with `RAYX_CPU_PROFILE=1`. Require exact final offset, renderer/Taffy/text/style ownership counters, 716 request-style reuses, 13 external candidates, and zero terminal errors. Aggregate sampled self time by function and subsystem, compare style compute/refine/drop and leading gpux-owned families with experiment 76, and produce a ranked list of single-mechanism candidates. Raw profiles remain under ignored `artifacts-temp`.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown:
### Expected Outcome

The profile should confirm that request/prepaint style construction is no longer the leading avoidable family and identify at least one higher-confidence gpux-owned mechanism for experiment 83, or establish that narrower telemetry is needed before another production change.

## Post Request Handoff CPU Profile Finished

**Index:** 82

### Report

**Passed Status**: true. The measurement-only headed WebGPU run passed at both DPRs with exact runtime invariants and no production changes.

The accepted request handoff reduced sampled `Style::refine` self time 65.64%/53.04%, `compute_style_internal` 57.04%/41.00%, StyleRefinement drop work 31.00%/35.59%, and aggregate Interactivity prepaint self time 30.57%/34.00% at DPR 1/2 versus experiment 76. This directly confirms the intended CPU mechanism independently of cadence noise.

The remaining dominant sampled family is upstream Taffy flexbox at 580.206/658.450 ms, followed by allocator malloc plus free at 459.027/480.608 ms. Allocation ancestry attributes 83.71/73.21 ms to flexbox, 28.27/23.61 ms to block layout, 28.11/37.93 ms to `div()` construction, 23.72/44.34 ms to Interactivity drop, 25.29/36.35 ms to Window draw, and 15.62/20.05 ms to GlobalElementId Arc path creation. The next step should inspect current upstream Taffy release/flex allocation changes before introducing local allocation machinery; if no safe upstream improvement exists, add narrow Div base-style allocation telemetry rather than speculatively inlining its large refinement.
